scripts.build: npm run build -w agentic-whiteboard-mcp && npm run build -w @agentic-whiteboard/webview && npm run build -w agentic-whiteboard
scripts.package: npm run build && npm run package -w agentic-whiteboard
scripts.publish:vscode: npm run build && npm run publish:vscode -w agentic-whiteboard
scripts.publish:openvsx: npm run build && npm run publish:openvsx -w agentic-whiteboard
scripts.publish:mcp: npm run build -w agentic-whiteboard-mcp && npm publish -w agentic-whiteboard-mcp --access public
scripts.publish:all: npm run publish:mcp && npm run publish:vscode && npm run publish:openvsx
